claims.object_text: radiation and cisplatin resistance of cells
claims.quote: loss of expression of the fragile site-encoded Wwox protein was found to contribute to radiation and cisplatin resistance of cells

claims.object_text: WWOX gene deletions occur in a variety of human cancer types, and reduced Wwox protein expression can be detected early during cancer development
claims.quote: WWOX gene deletions occur in a variety of human cancer types, and reduced Wwox protein expression can be detected early during cancer development.

claims.object_text: mouse embryo fibroblast cells from Wwox-knockout mice
claims.quote: Wwox loss is followed by mild chromosome instability in genomes of mouse embryo fibroblast cells from Wwox-knockout mice.

claims.object_text: enhanced survival of ionizing radiation and bleomycin treatment
claims.quote: Human and mouse cells deficient for Wwox also exhibit significantly enhanced survival of ionizing radiation and bleomycin treatment, agents that induce double-strand breaks (DSBs).

claims.object_text: xenograft model of irradiated breast cancer cells
claims.quote: Cancer cells that survive radiation recur more rapidly in a xenograft model of irradiated breast cancer cells; Wwox-deficient cells exhibited significantly shorter tumor latencies vs Wwox-expressing cells.

claims.object_text: shorter overall survival times in a cohort of cancer patients treated with radiation
claims.quote: In a cohort of cancer patients treated with radiation, Wwox deficiency significantly correlated with shorter overall survival times.

claims.object_text: enhanced homology directed repair (HDR) and decreased non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ) repair
claims.quote: Wwox-deficient cells exhibit enhanced homology directed repair (HDR) and decreased non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ) repair, suggesting that Wwox contributes to DNA DSB repair pathway choice.
Upon silencing of Rad51, a protein critical for HDR, Wwox-deficient cells were resensitized to radiation.
We also demonstrated interaction of Wwox with Brca1, a driver of HDR,

claims.object_text: suppresses DSB repair at the end-resection step of HDR
claims.quote: Wwox expression suppresses DSB repair at the end-resection step of HDR.

claims.object_text: genome caretaker function in which Brca1-Wwox interaction supports NHEJ as the dominant DSB repair pathway in Wwox-sufficient cells
claims.quote: We propose a genome caretaker function for WWOX, in which Brca1-Wwox interaction supports NHEJ as the dominant DSB repair pathway in Wwox-sufficient cells.
